rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment: Aptitude + Logical Reasoning + DSA coding (HackerRank, 90 min)
Round 2: Technical Interview: System Design (LLD/HLD), previous projects, data structures
Round 3: Managerial/HR: Behavioural questions, teamwork scenarios, Why TCS?
tips: Strong DSA fundamentals, design patterns, OOPs principles. Know your projects end-to-end.

rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment: 2 DSA problems (medium-hard), 45 min
Round 2: Technical Interview 1: Array/DP/Graph problems + time-space complexity analysis
Round 3: Technical Interview 2: LLD (Low Level Design) — design a parking lot system
Round 4: Bar Raiser + HR: Leadership Principles (STAR format answers essential)
tips: Amazon's Leadership Principles are non-negotiable. Prepare STAR stories for all 16 principles. DSA difficulty is higher than service companies.

rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment: 2 algorithmic problems (competitive programming level)
Round 2: Phone Screen: 1 coding problem + discussion on approach and complexity
Round 3: Onsite Round 1: Graphs + Dynamic Programming
Round 4: Onsite Round 2: System Design (scalable distributed system)
tips: Google emphasises algorithmic thinking over implementation speed. Practice on LeetCode Hard. System Design must cover scalability at Google-scale.

rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment: Aptitude + Logical + Verbal + Java MCQ
Round 2: Technical Interview: Core Java, OOPS principles, collections, multithreading
Round 3: HR Round: Career goals, relocation flexibility, Why Infosys?
tips: Focus on Java fundamentals, OOPs, and be clear about your career plan. The interview is relatively straightforward for a 42.9 LPA package.

rounds: Round 1: Online Assessment: 3 DSA problems (medium difficulty)
Round 2: Technical Interview 1: Data Structures (Trees, Graphs), problem-solving approach
Round 3: Technical Interview 2: OS concepts (threading, deadlocks), DBMS (indexing, normalization)
Round 4: HR Round: Culture fit, behavioural questions
tips: Microsoft values problem-solving approach over perfect solutions. Explain your thought process aloud. OS and DBMS knowledge is tested more than at other MNCs.
